AMUT.Settings.UseHandbook.Name: Use Mutant's Handbook rules
AMUT.Settings.UseHandbook.Hint: Replace the system's Corruption → mutation flow with The Mutant's Handbook rules: species type roll, TB/WPB Corruption loss, severity roll, compendium tables, GM-confirmed result card with a Resilience opt-out. Turn off for stock system behaviour.
AMUT.Settings.KeepingItRandom.Name: Optional rule: Keeping it Random
AMUT.Settings.KeepingItRandom.Hint: Handbook p9. Roll severity on a plain 1d100 with no bonus for existing mutations: 1-33 Trivial, 34-66 Minor, 67-99 Major, 100 Chosen of Chaos.
AMUT.Settings.LetThemOff.Name: Optional rule: Let them off with a warning!
AMUT.Settings.LetThemOff.Hint: Handbook p9. A character's first physical mutation is Trivial instead of rolling severity.
AMUT.Settings.PromptSource.Name: Ask for the mutation source
AMUT.Settings.PromptSource.Hint: After the severity roll, ask whether to roll on the Undivided, Necromantic or a Chaos God table. When off, the Undivided tables are used. Chosen of Chaos always use their patron's table.
AMUT.Settings.SpeciesFallback.Name: Species fallback
AMUT.Settings.SpeciesFallback.Hint: The handbook species table (p8) only lists Dwarf, Elf, Halfling, Human, Gnome and Ogre. Other species roll as this one.
AMUT.Step.LetThemOff: first physical mutation (Let them off with a warning!)
AMUT.Card.Title: Dissolution of Body and Mind
AMUT.Card.ChosenText: The character is Chosen by a Chaos God (p9). The GM picks the patron; from now on every mutation comes from the patron's table (p74). Picking a god also rolls this mutation on that table.
AMUT.Status.resistedBy: {name} spent 1 Resilience ({from} → {to}) to avoid the mutation. Corruption is still lost (p9).
AMUT.Note.ChooseOne: This result offers a choice: the GM adds one of the mutations below.
AMUT.Note.ManualSubtable: This mutation picks between several sub-tables; roll them by hand.
AMUT.Note.NurgleMisprint: Nurgle footnote ** on Corrupted Blood is a misprint (it lists skin types); the GM decides (p75).
AMUT.Note.FootnoteMiss: God footnote result "{name}" not found in the sub-table; rolled the full table instead.
AMUT.Note.StillFailed: {how}: the test still failed (rolled {roll} against {target}, SL {sl}). The mutation stands.
AMUT.Revert.Untracked: The added mutation was not recorded on this card; remove it from the sheet by hand.
AMUT.Spawn.Title: Chaos Spawn
AMUT.Spawn.Warning: {name} has more mutations than they can bear and becomes a mindless Chaos Spawn.
AMUT.Warn.NoActor: Mutant's Handbook: no actor found. Select a token or use the Generate Mutation macro.
AMUT.Warn.NoActors: Mutant's Handbook: you don't own any actors.
AMUT.Warn.NoTable: Table "{column}" not found in the module compendium.
AMUT.Warn.Missing: Mutation "{name}" not found in the module compendium.
AMUT.Warn.NoGM: A GM must be logged in to spend Resilience on this card.
AMUT.Warn.Rerolled: The Dissolution test for {name} was rerolled or had SL added, but its mutation card is from an older version of the module and isn't linked to the test. If the test now passes, discard that card and restore the lost Corruption by hand.
AMUT.Settings.AutoGrants.Name: Add the Talents, Traits, items and rolled modifiers a mutation grants
AMUT.Settings.AutoGrants.Hint: When a handbook mutation is added to an actor, also add the Talents, Creature Traits, Psychology, Skill advances, natural armour and linked mutations its text grants, asking for choices and rolling the in-text sub-tables, and roll or ask for its variable Characteristic, Movement and Wounds modifiers (1d10 rolls, hit locations, body parts, size steps). Deleting the mutation removes them again. Fixed modifiers are ordinary effects on the item and apply either way.
AMUT.Grant.Title: {name}: granted items
AMUT.Grant.Failed: {name}: adding the granted items failed ({error}). See the console.
AMUT.Grant.NoChoice: No choice made for "{text}"; add it by hand.
AMUT.Grant.NoVariant: No {table} result picked; add its items by hand.
AMUT.Grant.VariantMiss: {table} result "{label}" has no automation; apply it by hand.
AMUT.Grant.NoParts: {name} has no part list; add its items by hand.
AMUT.Grant.NotFound: Could not find the {type} "{name}" (is wfrp4e-core active?); add it by hand.
AMUT.Grant.SkillStub: Placeholder for {name} ({ref}), added by a mutation. Check its Characteristic against the book.
AMUT.Grant.SkillStubNote: {name} was not found in any compendium, so a placeholder skill was made ({ref}); check its Characteristic.
AMUT.Grant.SkillStubModule: Placeholder for {name} ({ref}), added by a mutation because {module} is not active. Replace it with the real skill once the module is enabled.
AMUT.Grant.SkillStubModuleNote: {module} is not active, so {name} was added as a placeholder skill ({char}, Advanced; {ref}). Swap in the real skill once the module is enabled.
AMUT.Grant.NaturalArmour: Natural armour from {name}. Deleting that mutation removes this item.
AMUT.Grant.NoBump: No {name} trait to add Damage to; adjust by hand.
AMUT.Grant.PickVariant: No {table} result is recorded on this mutation. Roll it, or pick one:
AMUT.Grant.NoPool: {name} has no {pool} (only characters do); change it by hand if needed.
AMUT.Power.OracleActive: {name} is already active: end it with its End button first.
AMUT.Power.OracleFailed: {name}: the future stays hidden (Willpower Test failed).
AMUT.Power.OracleReason: {name}: sensing the future, +{n} Fortune for the scene
AMUT.Power.LunacyAsk: What is Morrslieb's state? (Daytime: no effect.)
AMUT.Power.LunacyFullEnds: Lunacy: Morrslieb no longer full, unspent Fortune removed
AMUT.Power.ReachPenalty: Elongated Limbs: -10 Penalty to {attacker} for having the shorter weapon ({defender}'s long arms).
AMUT.Power.ReachEven: Elongated Limbs: {attacker}'s long arms make the weapons the same length, no shorter-weapon penalty (cancels the -10 below).
AMUT.Warn.NoPermission: You lack permission to do that: only a GM can use this button.
AMUT.Warn.NoPermissionAdd: You lack permission to add mutations to {name}.
AMUT.Warn.NoGMCard: The mutation was added, but no GM is logged in to mark this card as resolved.
AMUT.Warn.NoGMRevert: The test now passes, but a GM must be logged in to undo the mutation card.
AMUT.Act.NoTrait: The {name} Creature Trait was not found in wfrp4e-core: add it by hand for the duration.
AMUT.Act.NoGM: No GM is connected to apply this to the target: apply it by hand.
AMUT.Act.NotOwner: You do not have permission to use this character's mutations.
AMUT.Act.Active: {name} is already active: end it with its End button on the Effects tab first.
AMUT.Act.Rested: {name}: rested for 8 hours, teleporting is back to Average (+20).
AMUT.Act.Opposed: Opposed Test against {target}: the outcome is applied automatically once they roll.
AMUT.Act.ethereal.Label: insubstantial
AMUT.Act.ethereal.Success: Insubstantial for {n} Rounds (Willpower Bonus {wpb} + SL {sl}): the Ethereal Creature Trait is on, you can pass through solid objects and can only be harmed by Magical attacks.
AMUT.Act.ethereal.GM: If they turn solid with an arm or leg inside a solid object the limb is destroyed (Amputation, WFRP4e p180); with the body or head, they die.
AMUT.Act.invisibility.Label: invisible
AMUT.Act.invisibility.Success: Invisible for {n} Rounds (Willpower {wp} + SL {sl}, x{x} for repeats).
AMUT.Act.invisibility.GM: Concealed from everyone without Second Sight; those with it must pass a Challenging (+0) Perception Test to notice them nearby. It ends early on loud noise or an attack (End button).
AMUT.Act.levitation.Label: levitating
AMUT.Act.levitation.Success: Levitating for {n} Rounds (Willpower Bonus {wpb} + SL {sl}, x{x} for repeats): Flight ({rating}) is on.
AMUT.Act.swarmform.Label: in swarmform
AMUT.Act.swarmform.Rolled: Swarm creatures rolled (1d100 = {r}), kept for later transformations.
AMUT.Act.swarmform.Success: Transforms over 1 Round into a swarm of {type}: the Swarm Creature Trait is on until the End button.
AMUT.Act.swarmform.GM: Pick Size (Little) or Size (Tiny). Killed swarm members cost Wounds (1 per Little, 1 per 2 Tiny) and the body is injured as much on reforming; parts not present when reforming die.
AMUT.Act.shapeshifter.Label: assumed shape
AMUT.Act.shapeshifter.Success: Takes another humanoid shape of the same size for {n} hours (Toughness Bonus {tb} + SL {sl}); the transformation takes 1 Round.
AMUT.Act.shapeshifter.GM: Fools everyone without Second Sight. Seeing the transformation causes Fear 1 in those who don't know. If Wounded in the shape, a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test at -10 per Wound (offered in the roll dialog) or change back.
AMUT.Act.werebeast.Label: bestial form
AMUT.Act.werebeast.Phase.day: Absent, or daytime (-20 to turn, +20 to change back)
AMUT.Act.werebeast.Phase.small: Small (-10 to turn, +10 to change back)
AMUT.Act.werebeast.Phase.large: Large (+10 to turn, -10 to change back)
AMUT.Act.werebeast.Phase.full: Full (+20 to turn, -20 to change back)
AMUT.Act.werebeast.Success: Transforms over 1 Round into a bestial humanoid (Bestial form effect, until the End button or changing back).
AMUT.Act.werebeast.GM: Body, head and all limbs take the attributes of the beast rolled on the Bestial Body table: apply them while the form lasts.
AMUT.Act.werebeast.Back: Changes back to their own shape.
AMUT.Act.mirrorImage.Label: disguised
AMUT.Act.mirrorImage.Success: Takes another's likeness for {n} minutes (Willpower {wp} + SL {sl} x 10, x{x} for repeats).
AMUT.Act.mirrorImage.GM: Only someone they know, within one Size step. Fools everyone without Second Sight; those with it may roll Perception to notice something, but must dispel the magic to see through it.
AMUT.Act.phantasmalMind.Label: illusion
AMUT.Act.phantasmalMind.Success: Creates a static illusion lasting {n} minutes (Willpower {wp} + SL {sl} x 10).
AMUT.Act.phantasmalMind.GM: Fools everyone without Second Sight; those with it need a Difficult (-10) Perception Test to notice and must dispel it to see through. People outside the area don't see it.
AMUT.Act.temporalInstability.Success: Plunges forward in time: an extra Move and Action this Turn.
AMUT.Act.temporalInstability.Aged: Ageing roll 1d10 = {r}: ages a full year (age now {age}).
AMUT.Act.temporalInstability.AgedManual: Ageing roll 1d10 = {r}: ages a full year (the sheet's age is not a number, change it by hand).
AMUT.Act.dimensionalInstability.Ask: Teleports since the last 8 hours of rest: {used}. How many passengers (in physical contact)? Each one worsens the Difficulty one step, as does each earlier teleport.
AMUT.Act.dimensionalInstability.Success: Teleports, as the Move, up to {yards} yards to a place in sight, with {n} passenger(s) (up to SL {sl} allowed).
AMUT.Act.dimensionalInstability.TooMany: {n} passengers but only {sl} SL: only {sl} can come along.
AMUT.Act.dimensionalInstability.Capped: The Difficulty is already Very Hard (-30) and cannot worsen further.
AMUT.Act.telekinesis.Label: moving things
AMUT.Act.telekinesis.Move: Moves things at {yards} yards per Round for {n} Rounds; Willpower replaces Strength for weight and contested lifting.
AMUT.Act.telekinesis.Hurl: Now make the Ballistic Skill Test with the thrown weapon or rock; Willpower Bonus ({wpb}) replaces Strength Bonus.
AMUT.Act.pyrokinesis.Ignite: Things within {yards} yards catch fire (torches, camp fires; someone in flammable clothes or fur gains Ablaze).
AMUT.Act.pyrokinesis.Blast: A blast of fire {yards} yards across: Damage {dmg} (Willpower Bonus {wpb} + SL {sl}), Toughness and Armour protect as usual; everyone in it must pass an Average (+20) Endurance Test or gain 1 Ablaze.
AMUT.Act.greenSovereign.Small: Plants within {yards} yards shed leaves, ripen fruit or rattle their branches.
AMUT.Act.greenSovereign.Strike: Now make the Weapon Skill Test: branches count as an Improvised Weapon, roots and vines can grapple, and Willpower Bonus ({wpb}) replaces Strength Bonus.
AMUT.Act.windCaller.Use.small: Make the wind do small things
AMUT.Act.windCaller.Small: The wind blows slightly less or more within {yards} yards.
AMUT.Act.windCaller.Gust: A gust fills a sail, cleans a room or topples an object; Willpower Bonus ({wpb}) replaces Strength Bonus. Stunning an opponent needs an Opposed Test.
AMUT.Act.thunderhead.Shock: Target the person you touch: they oppose with Toughness, and if you win they gain 1 Stunned. In combat a Melee (Brawling) Test must touch them first.
AMUT.Act.thunderhead.Bolt: A lightning bolt at a target within {yards} yards: Damage {dmg} (Willpower Bonus {wpb} + SL {sl}) and 1 Blinded.
AMUT.Act.thunderhead.BoltGM: Metal armour does not protect against the damage: apply it and the Blinded Condition to the target.
AMUT.Act.telepathy.Project: Projects thoughts into a mind within {yards} yards; they can reply the same way without a Test.
AMUT.Act.telepathy.Pluck: Superficial thoughts have no modifier, memories -30 (option in the roll dialog). Under 2 SL the target notices. No effect on non-sentient creatures.
AMUT.Act.lifeLeech.Object: Drains an object: {dmg} Armour Point reduction, and heals {dmg} Wounds.
AMUT.Act.lifeLeech.Creature: Drains {target}: {dmg} Damage ignoring Armour (Toughness still counts), {dealt} Wounds lost, and heals {dealt} Wounds.
AMUT.Act.lifeLeech.GM: In combat an Opposed Melee (Brawling) Test must touch first; no normal damage is rolled. A meal's worth of food per point of damage.
AMUT.Act.bloomblightTouch.Heal: Heals the touched creature {n} Wounds (Fellowship {fel} + SL {sl}): target one token to apply it.
AMUT.Act.bloomblightTouch.GM: The healed creature must pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or suffer {symptom} for {days} days (rolled 1d100 = {r}, 1d10 days).
AMUT.Act.evilEye.GM: If the mutant wins the Opposed Willpower Test, the target gains 1 Fatigued and must pass a Hard (-20) Endurance Test or gain Prone. If the mutant loses, they gain 1 Stunned.
AMUT.Act.entrancement.GM: If the mutant wins, the target wants to please them for Willpower Bonus ({wpb}) + SL hours: +20 to social Tests with them (option in the roll dialog). A Critical makes the target cause a scene. At most {max} people entranced at once.
AMUT.Act.beastAlpha.GM: Commands an animal or bestial monster (Intelligence 15 or less) that can hear the voice: domestic (Broken) animals +20, monsters -20 (options in the roll dialog). Convey intent, not instructions.
AMUT.Act.fleshcrafter.Cosmetic: Cosmetic change: the GM decides the SL needed for a disguise, to change Fellowship or to gain Attractive.
AMUT.Act.fleshcrafter.Drastic: Drastic change: on a success, trade up to {sl} point(s) between physical Characteristics (GM's call, by hand). Charm, Intimidation or even Fear at the GM's discretion.
AMUT.Act.fleshcrafter.Bone: Bone: change stature or height (within the species' Size), grow bone spikes or craft bone items.
AMUT.Act.fleshcrafter.Fumble: Critical failure: a negative effect, quite possibly the opposite of what was intended. Not usable in combat; takes minutes or hours.
AMUT.Act.chameleonSkin.Pass: The skin stays its normal colour for the scene.
AMUT.Act.chameleonSkin.Fail: The skin adapts to the surroundings this scene: anyone watching sees the mutation (+20 Stealth while blending in).
AMUT.Act.possessed.Pass: The demon stays in the depths of the mind.
AMUT.Act.possessed.Fail: The demon takes control for {n} {unit}; the character blacks out and remembers nothing.
AMUT.Act.chosenOne.Pass: Their god's attention is elsewhere today: they won't rely on their powers for the rest of the day.
AMUT.Act.chosenOne.Fail: Their god is favourable today: they will try to use their powers when ordinary Talents or Skills would make more sense.
AMUT.Act.falseWizard.Pass: The Winds are weak today: they won't rely on their magic for the rest of the day.
AMUT.Act.falseWizard.Fail: The Winds blow strong today: they will try to use their magic when ordinary Talents or Skills would make more sense.
AMUT.Act.doomProphet.Pass: The doom can wait another day.
AMUT.Act.doomProphet.Fail: They must preach the coming doom for at least 30 impassioned minutes today, or automatically fail tonight's Rest Test and gain 1 Fatigued tomorrow.
AMUT.Act.metamorphosis.Pass: The experiments can wait another day.
AMUT.Act.metamorphosis.Fail: They must conduct an experiment that pushes the boundaries of existence today, or automatically fail tonight's Rest Test and gain 1 Fatigued tomorrow.
AMUT.Act.rebelliousMind.Pass: The rebellion can wait another day.
AMUT.Act.rebelliousMind.Fail: They must preach what has to be done for at least 30 impassioned minutes today, or automatically fail tonight's Rest Test and gain 1 Fatigued tomorrow.
AMUT.Act.saintOfTheDamned.Pass: They can relax their role as tempter today.
AMUT.Act.saintOfTheDamned.Fail: They must move at least one person to act outside their morals today, or automatically fail tonight's Rest Test and gain 1 Fatigued tomorrow.
AMUT.Act.Waiting: Waiting for {user} to roll the {test} Test for {actor}.
AMUT.Act.NotRolled: {title}: the {test} Test for {actor} was not rolled. Apply its outcome by hand.
AMUT.Act.OpposedWon: {actor} wins the Opposed Test against {target} by {sl} SL.
AMUT.Act.evilEye.Won: {target} doubles up in pain and gains 1 Fatigued, and must pass a Hard (-20) Endurance Test or gain Prone.
AMUT.Act.evilEye.FailText: Doubles up in pain and gains the Prone Condition.
AMUT.Act.entrancement.Won: {target} desperately wants to please the mutant for {n} hours (Willpower Bonus {wpb} + {sl} SL): +20 to social Tests with them.
AMUT.Act.entrancement.Critical: Critical: {target} is too eager and lovesick to act discreetly, causing a scene or a blunder.
AMUT.Act.entrancement.Max: At most {max} people can be entranced at once.
AMUT.Act.entrancement.EffectText: Desperately wants to please {actor}, but keeps their sense of self-preservation. {actor} has +20 to social interaction with them.
AMUT.Act.beastAlpha.Lost: {target} does not submit to the mutant.
AMUT.Act.beastAlpha.Rules: The beast must hear your voice and needs intent, not instructions. Domestic (Broken) animals +20, monsters -20 (options in the roll dialog).
AMUT.Act.thunderhead.ShockTouch: In combat, a Melee (Brawling) Test must touch the target first.
AMUT.Act.thunderhead.ShockLost: The charge has no effect on {target}.
AMUT.Act.thunderhead.BoltHit: The lightning bolt hits {target} ({loc}) for {dmg} Damage (Willpower Bonus {wpb} + SL {sl}); only non-metal armour protects ({ap} AP), and they gain 1 Blinded.
AMUT.Act.telepathy.Unnoticed: Plucks thoughts from {target}'s mind without them noticing ({sl} SL).
AMUT.Act.telepathy.Noticed: Plucks thoughts from {target}'s mind, but with under 2 SL ({sl}) they become aware of it.
AMUT.Act.telepathy.Lost: Fails to pluck thoughts from {target}'s mind.
AMUT.Act.pyrokinesis.BlastAt: A blast of fire {yards} yards across: Damage {dmg} (Willpower Bonus {wpb} + SL {sl}), Toughness and Armour protect as usual.
AMUT.Act.pyrokinesis.BlastHit: {target} takes {dmg} Damage ({loc}) and must pass an Average (+20) Endurance Test or gain 1 Ablaze.
AMUT.Act.bloomblightTouch.Test: {target} must pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or suffer {symptom} for {days} days (1d100 = {r}, 1d10 days).
AMUT.Act.bloomblightTouch.NoSymptom: The {symptom} symptom isn't set up (core module needed): apply it for {days} days by hand if the Endurance Test fails.
AMUT.Grant.Fright.Repeat: Another Fright: raise the Terror of a fear you already have, or add a new source?
AMUT.Grant.Fright.Specific: Source of your fright ({source}): if it is a category, pick something specific
AMUT.Grant.Override.Ask: You already have natural armour there ({names}). Does the new Protective Skin replace it?
AMUT.Grant.Override.Replace: Replace it: {names} no longer counts (worn again if this mutation is removed)
